map.最大回撤（本页代码口径）：MD=(峰值−谷值)÷峰值×100（%）；联动量：回撤: Maximum drawdown (this page's code basis): MD = (peak − trough) ÷ peak × 100 (%); linked values: drawdown magnitude (absolute) = peak − trough, gain needed to recover = (peak ÷ (trough||1) − 1) × 100 (%, with the denominator falling back to 1 when the trough is 0). Validation: both fields are required valid numbers via the input guard, otherwise a prompt stops the run. Criteria: no fixed grading; the deeper the drawdown, the more the required recovery gain grows nonlinearly with the trough denominator (e.g. a 50% drawdown needs a 100% rise to recover).
